entries.013e3ba499c31ec4: As its core strategy, the company sets out 'DX of the BtoB transaction market' and is working to digitize the domestic distribution structure through the BtoB wholesale mall 'NETSEA' and other means. Going forward, it positions the D2X commerce area, through OEM own-brand sales under 'AP LAB' and live commerce under 'NETSEA MallLive', as a new growth driver, and is advancing the restructuring of its business portfolio and selection and focus.

entries.06e8a2df206f7a42: Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥4,657 million. By business, the Solutions Business generated ¥2,789 million, the Platform Business ¥1,610 million, and the Incubation Business ¥257 million.

Meanwhile, as part of the restructuring of unprofitable businesses, it ended the 'NETSEA Auction' service and transferred the Amazon seller-only app 'Amacode' to a third party.

entries.1a4d8c334f034958: It is a business that supports the distribution of companies' inventory and slow-moving products, and operates multiple marketplaces online and offline. In addition to providing the BtoB wholesale mall “NETSEA” and the offline exhibition and business meeting business “OSR Exhibition and Business Meeting,” it operates D2X commerce, which sells products manufactured in China to buyers and consumers in Japan (OEM own-brand sales “AP LAB” and live commerce “NETSEA MallLive”). NETSEA Auction, which had supported the liquidation of slow-moving inventory, returns and discontinued products, ended its service in March 2025. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,610 million.
entries.202f28ceaa58d737: The company is headquartered in Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo, and conducts its business together with eight consolidated subsidiaries.
entries.20fcd2d429ce8226: It is a business that sells products manufactured at factories and suppliers in China to buyers and consumers in Japan. OEM own-brand sales “AP LAB” itself develops factories and manufactures at its production bases in China, and in addition to sales to individuals, it also wholesales to corporations. Live commerce “NETSEA MallLive” purchases products itself and sells them through live streaming. Its main revenue model is sales revenue from product transactions. Amounts are not disclosed separately, so they are not stated.
